outcome_summary: Implemented end-to-end integration of standalone developer plan executions into the project ledger across 10 work packages: a new `ledger_import_standalone` MCP tool (30th tool), a `LedgerStore.importStandaloneProject()` storage method, a `standalone-archiver` ledger-support persona, an automatic dispatch step in the standalone developer persona, and a CLI batch-import command with dry-run and batch modes. All 43 pipeline stages passed with zero regressions, two security audits yielding zero Critical/High findings, and approximately 49 new targeted tests. The sole scope gap is GUI detail page verification for `runner:'standalone'` imported projects (original WP-008.md spec displaced by a ledger setup anomaly during project creation), which requires a dedicated follow-up WP before the feature ships.
